verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to define event-triggered rules. Zapier integration means the rules live in an external tool. The Socket API and multi-task jobs are developer building blocks, and credit auto-refill is an unrelated billing feature, so none of these count. The evidence also documents no native webhook or trigger-rule feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
